sources.name: FantasyCalc
sources.required_before_commercial_deployment: Obtain express written permission/license from FantasyCalc or remove/replace the dependency.
sources.notes: FantasyCalc states that its data is copyrighted and may not be used commercially without express written permission. Public accessibility is not a commercial license.

sources.name: Sleeper API
sources.required_before_commercial_deployment: Obtain a commercial/API licensing agreement or approved integration status from Sleeper, or redesign ingestion around a separately authorized data path.
sources.notes: Sleeper's API documentation says the read-only API is free for non-commercial use and instructs commercial users to contact Sleeper for licensing. Current general terms also restrict commercial third-party retrieval/synchronization without express consent.

sources.name: Stats Guy Fantasy
candidate_uses: independent benchmark for future-pick time-discount curves
commercially permissible current dynasty market anchor challenger
historical market snapshots for temporal validation
conditions: Use documented public API rather than scraping.
Public products displaying Stats Guy Fantasy data must visibly credit and link to Stats Guy Fantasy.
Do not resell or republish the data wholesale as a standalone or competing data service.
sources.notes: The documented API explicitly permits commercial products and provides historical snapshots. This makes it a candidate challenger/bridge source, not automatically the preferred long-term FSFFL dependency.

sources.name: FSFFL model-derived parameters
sources.required_before_commercial_deployment: For each derived parameter family, document whether the training/calibration evidence is first-party, commercially licensed/permissive, or restricted; restricted upstream data must not be assumed safe merely because it was transformed into a coefficient.
sources.notes: This is a governance rule rather than an external provider. A proprietary formula can still carry commercialization risk if it is mechanically derived from a restricted upstream dataset.

commercialization_blockers.reason: Active nonprojection market and future-pick anchor is not licensed for commercial use.
Core league/roster/transaction ingestion depends on an API whose published documentation limits free use to non-commercial purposes.

next_actions: Benchmark Stats Guy Fantasy future-pick curves against current FantasyCalc-derived curves without replacing production assumptions solely because licensing is easier.
Build an FSFFL-owned future-pick time-value challenger from commercially permissible or licensed historical transaction evidence where identifiable.
Audit every remaining nonprojection external dataset and add it to this registry before commercial deployment.
Separately audit projection-source licensing in the active projection workstream to avoid branch conflicts.
